# Call onError for a rejection that is not an Error

Issue: re-cinq/HALEngine#95
Labels: priority:medium, type:bug, size:S, area:api

## Why

The orchestrator's `catch` gates `onError` on `error instanceof Error`. A rejection that is not an `Error` — a thrown string, a plain object, a value from a library that rejects with its own shape — bypasses `onError` entirely while still propagating to the caller.

`onError` is the seam a deployer uses to count failures, page someone, or write an incident record. A gate that silently drops a class of failures makes it a liar in exactly the cases nobody tested for, and the deployer's dashboard reads "no errors" while the caller sees rejections.

Recorded as measured behaviour in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` by HALEngine#83, which scoped itself to specifying the seam rather than changing it, and raised again by the reviewer on that PR. The spec notes this property is owned by no issue in the epic; this is that issue.

## What to do

Call `onError` for every rejection. Whatever is not already an `Error` gets wrapped in one, preserving the original as the `cause`, so a hook typed against `Error` keeps compiling and a hook that wants the raw value can still reach it. The re-thrown value at the caller boundary stays exactly what it is today, so nothing downstream changes shape.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A provider rejecting with a string calls `onError` once, with an `Error` whose `cause` is that string, and the caller still receives the original rejection unchanged
- [ ] The same holds for a rejection with a plain object and with `undefined`
- [ ] A rejection that is already an `Error` reaches `onError` as the same instance, not a wrapper, pinned by the existing tests remaining unedited
- [ ] `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` replaces its recorded-flaw line with the new guarantee, and the CHANGELOG says what changes for an existing consumer
- [ ] `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run eslint` (`--max-warnings 0`) and `npm run prettier:check` pass

## Tech notes

Key files: `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` (the `catch` and its `instanceof Error` gate), `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`.

Out of scope: `beforeSession` escaping the `try` (its own issue) and usage accounting across tool rounds (HALEngine#93).

# Lore test-command interface (lore_list_tests / lore_run_test).
# Written for this repo's Jest suite rather than adapted from the Vitest
# equivalent for a Vitest suite: the report shapes happen to match, but the
# invocations do not.
- id: hal-engine-jest
  name: HAL Engine Jest suite
  cwd: .
  description: >-
    The ts-jest unit suite over src/ and scripts/ (jest.config.js roots), run
    on every pull request in .github/workflows/ci.yml as the "Test" step.
    Selectors are "<repo-relative-file>::<full test name>" as emitted by the
    list command. Jest has no dry-run, so the list command executes the suite
    once with --json and derives every name from the report; it deliberately
    tolerates a red suite, since listing must not depend on the tests passing.
    The run command selects one test with --runTestsByPath plus an anchored,
    regex-escaped -t, and treats a selector that matches nothing as a failure
    rather than a green run of an empty suite. Neither command builds first:
    no test here reads dist/.
  list: node scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
  run: node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs "{selector}"
  coverage_format: lcov

# Definition of Done

> A rejection that is not an `Error` — a thrown string, a plain object, a value from a library that rejects with its own shape — bypasses `onError` entirely while still propagating to the caller.

**Strategy: `direct`** — The seam exists: `createChatOrchestrator(...).processMessage` runs the `catch` in `processMessageStream` with a real `AIProvider` whose stream rejects with the given value. The acceptance test calls that entry point today and fails on the `instanceof Error` gate.

## Done when these pass

- [ ] **calls onError once with an Error whose cause is a string, and rejects the caller with the original value** — a string rejection reaches `onError` once as an `Error` with `cause` set to the string, and the caller still receives the same string.
  `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **calls onError once with an Error whose cause is a plain object, and rejects the caller with the original value** — same guarantee for a plain-object rejection.
  `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **calls onError once with an Error whose cause is undefined, and rejects the caller with the original value** — same guarantee for an `undefined` rejection.
  `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`

## Facets

- [ ] Gate `onError` in the `catch` of `processMessageStream` on the rejection being an `Error` wrapped with `cause`, not on `instanceof Error` alone (`src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`). An `Error` rejection must still reach `onError` as the same instance: the existing `onError` tests in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` (`called with session and error when stream fails`, `error still propagates after onError hook`) stay green and unedited.
- [ ] Keep the re-thrown value at the caller boundary exactly as it was.
- [ ] Replace the recorded-flaw line in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` ("Measured semantics — out of scope") with the new guarantee, and give it a validated-by parenthetical pointing at the acceptance test.
- [ ] Add a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased saying `onError` now fires for non-`Error` rejections, wrapped in an `Error` whose `cause` is the original value, and what an existing consumer must change (a hook that assumed only `Error`s will now also see wrapped values).

## Out of scope

- `beforeSession` escaping the `try` — its own issue.
- Usage accounting across tool rounds — HALEngine#93.
- Changing what the caller receives: the rejection stays the original value.
- Spec `Status` rows: untouched.

# Definition of Done

> A rejection that is not an `Error` — a thrown string, a plain object, a value from a library that rejects with its own shape — bypasses `onError` entirely while still propagating to the caller.

**Strategy: `direct`** — The seam exists: `createChatOrchestrator(...).processMessage` runs the `catch` in `processMessageStream` with a real `AIProvider` whose stream rejects with the given value. The acceptance test calls that entry point today and fails on the `instanceof Error` gate.

## Done when these pass

- [ ] **calls onError once with an Error whose cause is a string, and rejects the caller with the original value** — a string rejection reaches `onError` once as an `Error` with `cause` set to the string, and the caller still receives the same string.
      `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **calls onError once with an Error whose cause is a plain object, and rejects the caller with the original value** — same guarantee for a plain-object rejection.
      `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`
- [ ] **calls onError once with an Error whose cause is undefined, and rejects the caller with the original value** — same guarantee for an `undefined` rejection.
      `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`

Existing tests that must stay green and unedited: `onError` › `called with session and error when stream fails` and `error still propagates after onError hook` in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. They pin that an `Error` reaches `onError` as the same instance.

## Facets

- [ ] Gate `onError` in the `catch` of `processMessageStream` on the rejection being an `Error` wrapped with `cause`, not on `instanceof Error` alone (`src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`).
- [ ] Keep the re-thrown value at the caller boundary exactly as it was.
- [ ] Replace the recorded-flaw line in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` ("Measured semantics — out of scope") with the new guarantee, and give it a validated-by parenthetical pointing at the acceptance test.
- [ ] Add a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased saying `onError` now fires for non-`Error` rejections, wrapped in an `Error` whose `cause` is the original value, and what an existing consumer must change (a hook that assumed only `Error`s will now also see wrapped values).

## Out of scope

- `beforeSession` escaping the `try` — its own issue.
- Usage accounting across tool rounds — HALEngine#93.
- Changing what the caller receives: the rejection stays the original value.
- Spec `Status` rows: untouched.

## Red bar

The red bar for these tests was run locally with
`node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`
and failed 3 of 3 with `Expected length: 1, Received length: 0` on `onErrorCalls`.

The acceptance tests for #95 are red for the ticket's stated reason, and the branch is pushed. The work from an earlier round was already on the branch; I checked it and tidied `.lore/dod.md`.

**Strategy: `direct`.** `createChatOrchestrator(...).processMessage` is the real seam, and a provider that rejects with the value under test reaches the `catch`.

**Acceptance tests** (`src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`, one `it.each` with three rows):
- a string rejection calls `onError` once with an `Error` whose `cause` is that string, and the caller gets the original value
- a plain-object rejection, same guarantee
- an `undefined` rejection, same guarantee

**Red bar** (run here with `node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`):

```
FAIL src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts
  ● onError for a rejection that is not an Error › calls onError once with an Error whose cause is a string, and rejects the caller with the original value

    expect(received).toHaveLength(expected)

    Expected length: 1
    Received length: 0
    Received array:  []

      56 |       expect(onErrorCalls).toHaveLength(1);
Tests:       3 failed, 3 total
```

The plain-object and `undefined` rows fail with the same `Expected length: 1 / Received length: 0`. The cause is the `instanceof Error` gate in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`, which is the ticket's claim and nothing else.

**Changes this round:**
- Rewrote `.lore/dod.md` to the required layout. I removed an extra "Red bar" section, and folded the existing-tests note into the gate facet.
- Ran prettier on it, committed as `8de4feb`, merged `origin/main` (already up to date), and pushed. `git status` reports the branch in sync with `origin/loop-bench/95`.

**Not done here:** the spec traceability and CHANGELOG are facets for the implementing round, not tests. The "Measured semantics — out of scope" heading the dod names exists at `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md:24`.

**Finding for the author:** the ticket's acceptance criteria also list `npm run build`, `typecheck`, `eslint` and `prettier:check`. CI runs those, and I did not run them here.
